en: Improved keyboard support over SSH and in unrecognized terminals: terminals that answer the kitty keyboard query (such as foot and Alacritty 0.16+) now get Shift+Enter and Ctrl+Shift shortcuts
zh: 改进通过 SSH 以及在未识别终端中的键盘支持：能响应 kitty 键盘查询的终端（如 foot 和 Alacritty 0.16+）现在支持 Shift+Enter 和 Ctrl+Shift 快捷键
